summary: Outside the skyscraper, the Agents lead a handcuffed Neo out of the revolving doors, forcing his head down as they push him into a dark sedan. Meanwhile, Trinity watches the scene unfold in the rearview mirror of her motorcycle. Seeing Neo captured, she reacts with a single curse word, "Shit."

what_changes.before: Free but being hunted, fleeing the Agents through the office building.
what_changes.after: Handcuffed and forced into the dark sedan, now in the Agents' custody.
what_changes.evidence: The Agents lead a handcuffed Neo out of the revolving doors

what_changes.before: Unaware of Neo's fate, watching from her motorcycle.
what_changes.after: Sees Neo captured in her rearview mirror and reacts with dismay.
